descriptions.description: A stubborn and a bit fidgety solution to use YouTube 10.11.11546 on older iOS (7-10)
Created by GitHub user piercingimpulse. Repo-nized by NinMan64.
REQUIRES YOUTUBE APP VERSION 10.11.11546 TO WORK!

Note: to actually use this tweak, download one of these files, extract, and copy the contents of the .zip in the YouTube Bundles/Youtube.app folder! Filza and Safari+/Safari Download Manager is helpful for this and i would highly reccomend to install these first!

Web (Requires API key - add your api key in the API_KEY.js folder in the js folder!) - https://github.com/piercingimpulse/verduraiOS/releases/download/v.0.0.2beta/web.zip Weblight (Doesn't require API key - just copy and paste!) - https://github.com/piercingimpulse/verduraiOS/releases/download/v.0.0.2beta/weblight.zip
